tools.name: proxy_list
tools.description: Fetch live free proxies from HProxy's public pool, re-checked around the clock. No key. Returns ip, port, protocols, anonymity, country, city, network, latency and 24h uptime per proxy. Use this when the user wants free proxies to test with. Free proxies are public and come and go, so check them bef

tools.name: proxy_check
tools.description: Run a real live test on one or more proxies: is it alive, which protocols it speaks, its anonymity grade, latency and location. No key. Each check opens a real connection, so a dead proxy can take a few seconds. Up to 25 per call.

tools.name: ip_lookup
tools.description: Look up any public IP address: country, region, city, coordinates, timezone, ASN and the network that runs it. No key. Up to 50 per call.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "proxy_list" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
